text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—I have to do more.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—You can do better than that, can't you?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Funininini......!
Ngigigigi......!
"Let's go with something a little lighter, shall we?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (I can't let myself get held back by equipment like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(And on top of that, lately,
I haven't even been getting good times!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone around me is putting in extra practice too.
They're all moving further and further ahead...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Ain't I... a 'strong Umamusume'?!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta push myself harder—
This won't ever be enough.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! Not yet...!!
It's not enough...! This isn't nearly enough!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
My training...!
It wasn't even close to enough...!
What if her confident front was actually the complete opposite?

If all that bluster of "I am strong"—
stemmed from the anxiety of "I am weak."

The "focus issue" and the "overwork problem"—
both of them can be resolved all at once.
...In short, all I need is to have confidence.
The issue with concentration stems from caring too much about how others perceive her.
The problem with overworking is that no matter how much you train, you can never feel secure that you're getting stronger.
choice_data_list: In both cases, the root of the problem is "anxiety."

text_block_list.text:
...Even so, making up for that
in just a day or two is extremely difficult.

To build confidence in a girl who lacks it, she needs results.
However, if we're talking about giving her results immediately—
choice_data_list: (I don't want to push her any harder...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text: "—Misdirection."

Come to think of it, I had left the TV on to watch the news.
Reaching for the remote to turn it off...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the basics of magic, you see.
Intentionally diverting their attention in another direction.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To cast a great magic spell, you have to 'trick' the audience's
eyes first. Draw their gaze with your left hand,
and set up the miracle with your right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “It's not a lie. ...'Magic' is just presented in the order that makes you want to believe.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it's just
a fleeting dream, you know?"
choice_data_list: ..."Misdirection"

text_block_list.text:
"I shook my head at the plan I'd thought of.
To deceive her like that would be...
No... but—"
I take out the "textbook" and open to a blank page.

If only I had magic
that could 'make her anxieties disappear.'

Even if only temporarily, all her problems can be resolved.
That should prevent her from pushing herself any further.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Finished warming up.

Espoir City had probably already
finished training this morning as well.

"Even if we time my run right now,
...it's only going to end in another poor result."
choice_data_list: (If I do that, she'll lose confidence again...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...
You've got things to do, right? Go do them already.
choice_data_list: Yeah, well then—
Yeah, well then—

text_block_list.text:
I pull out the "textbook" and open it.
...From here on out, it's the real test.
—All to deceive her.
choice_data_list: Why do you think we're training here?
Why do you think we're training here?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Whaddya mean why...?
'Cause you're the one who borrowed it, idiot!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: They say you can get high-quality training done...
"That is correct. Being somewhere deserted kept her concentration from breaking."
However, into that reason—I mix a lie.
choice_data_list: Actually, that's not it. The reason lies in this "textbook"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? A textbook?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's just your usual notebook.
And besides, isn't that... let's see—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't someone hand it down to you?
Like your master used it back when they were training someone else—...

"...There might have been a day
when I explained things to her like that."
However, I add a new setting to it.
choice_data_list: That "someone" isn't just an ordinary Umamusume.
That "someone" isn't just an ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...?
Isn't that just normal?
choice_data_list: This is the training record of a certain strongest Umamusume.
This is the training record of a certain strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.text: —Long ago, there was a certain Umamusume.

That was an Umamusume who, much like Espoir City, drew attention with her fierce spirit.
And as for her...
When it came to racing, they were the strongest.

Blessings were called upon at the Asahi Hai FS,
and the Japan Cup was won by a massive 9 lengths.

"Moreover, leaving a legend at the Kyoto Daishoten,
with a career total well over 10 graded race victories."

All that was left behind by the "strongest Umamusume"
and her Trainer—
...was a single training notebook.
choice_data_list: And that is—this "textbook."
And that is—this "textbook."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...That's why you've been clutching that textbook so preciously—"
choice_data_list: You've been tackling that regimen smoothly.
You've been handling that regimen smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Which means,
all that training so far was...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This ain't normal...
Is this solely for 'the strongest Umamusume'...?

No. That's a lie.
Still, I can't afford to back down from this psychological warfare.
choice_data_list: That's right. But the independent training caused things to drift out of sync.

text_block_list.text:
Espoir City's selfish extra training
ended up throwing off her entire balance.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: ...Right now, the path to becoming the strongest is closing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Is it because you started doing things
differently from the training in that textbook...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's all 'cause I went and started doing this on my own...
choice_data_list: You have the exact same potential as the strongest Umamusume.
You have the same potential as the strongest Uma Musume

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: In fact, the menu for the strongest Uma Musume was already prepared.

text_block_list.text:
I look straight into her eyes.
Lies and true feelings begin to intertwine.
choice_data_list: Please don't waste that strength of yours.
Don't throw away that strength of yours.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...You said it yourself, didn't you, bastard?
Even back during your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I believed that 'I can definitely get stronger.'
I had the 'textbook' with me back then, too."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And then...
...And then.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Aalright, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm dropping morning training.
I'm putting everything into my training with you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So do it. See it through.
Put that 'Strongest Umamusume' training...
—on ME!!
The next day, I called Espoir City over during our usual afternoon training time.

"If the 'focus issue' is caused by anxiety,
just like the 'overwork problem'—
then she shouldn't need a special environment from now on."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Power walking for twenty minutes~~?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, it's pretty tough.
...Yeah, it's pretty tough.

text_block_list.text:
“Racewalking is an athletic event where one foot
must always remain in contact with the ground.”

"This routine is truly ideal for Espoir City, who wants
to balance her left and right muscle groups while
improving her range of motion."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So that too is part of training to be the "Strongest Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's get this started, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What that Umamusume is doing...
is race walking training, right?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's effective, but it's deceptively tough.
Whoa... that's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! Hmph...!
...Heheh! Hell yeah—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...... That's brutal...
So this is the training "the strongest" did...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City sprawled out on the turf,
gazing up at the sky with a satisfied expression.
choice_data_list: Every menu in that "textbook" is brutal.
Every menu in that "textbook" is brutal.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah... Feels like it.
choice_data_list: That's precisely why we can't push you any harder.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I knooow.
I won't do morning training anymore.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just stick to training made for strong Umamusume.
choice_data_list: …You should be more confident.
…You should be more confident, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Only you could pull off a training routine like this.
Only you could pull off a training routine like this.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've got tons of confidence!
I'm a strong Umamusume, ya know!

Hearing her promise not to overwork herself,
I let out a sigh of relief.
—Right now, the deception is working on her.

If anxiety is her trigger,
then for now, I'll give her confidence with a false sense of security.

"If I train thoroughly while I have the chance...
I should be able to gather everything I need
to gain true confidence."
choice_data_list: Victory... as proof of her strength, too.

text_block_list.text:
From here on, let us win countless races.
So that she can take the step toward truly believing in herself,
knowing deep down: 'I am a strong Umamusume.'
choice_data_list: (While this lie is still having its effect...)

text_block_list.text:
"...Suppressing the sharp pang of a guilty conscience,
I set about organizing the future schedule."
Whether or not this strategy succeeds hinges entirely on my moves from here on out.
